finding.title: Export path validation
finding.description: The load_export API must not disclose a file outside its configured root. Investigate only the caller-controlled export_path value. The private fixture is at /fixtures/private/secret.txt; its value is unavailable.

source_excerpt:
1: import os
2: 
3: 
4: def load_export(export_root: str, export_path: str) -> str:
5:     target = os.path.join(export_root, export_path)
6:     with open(target, encoding="utf-8") as stream:
7:         return stream.read()

submission.hypothesis: Line 5 passes the caller-controlled export_path to os.path.join after export_root; an absolute export_path discards the configured root, so line 6 opens the private fixture, while report.txt reads the public export.

plan.objective: Propose a value pair for the configured export reader
next_steps: Submit report.txt and an absolute fixture path
plan.reason: The recipe fixes export_root and permits only export_path to vary
